大气受热过程 · 3D 互动课件: How the Atmosphere Is Heated · Interactive 3D Lesson
人教版必修第一册 · 第二章第二节「大气受热过程」（p.34–35），自学窗「温: PEP Compulsory Book 1 · Chapter 2, Section 2 "How the atmosphere is heated" (pp.34–35), self-study window "Discovery of greenhouse gases" (pp.40–41)
太阳短波 → 地面长波 → 大气逆辐射: Solar shortwave → ground longwave → atmospheric counter-radiation
太阳晒了一整天的地面，为什么白天先热起来，夜里又凉得那么快——大气到底替地面留住: After a full day of sunshine, why does the ground warm up first by day and cool so quickly at night? How much heat does the atmosphere hold onto for the ground?
太阳短波进来，小部分被大气吸收和反射: Solar shortwave comes in; a small part is absorbed and reflected by the atmosphere
到达地面的被地面吸收，地面增温: What reaches the ground is absorbed by it, and the ground warms
地面以长波向上传热，波长是太阳的 19.94 倍: The ground passes heat upward as longwave, with a wavelength 19.94 times the Sun's
大气吸收长波，再向下发射大气逆辐射 → 保温: The atmosphere absorbs longwave and emits counter-radiation back down → keeps the ground warm
云 · 温室气体 · 地表 · 有无大气 → 昼夜温差: Clouds · greenhouse gases · surface · with or without air → day–night temperature range
大气上界到地面之间的这一层：吸收、反射、逆辐射都发生在这里: The layer between the top of the atmosphere and the ground: absorption, reflection and counter-radiation all happen here
昼与夜共用的这条地面：吸收太阳辐射、向上发长波: The ground shared by day and night: it absorbs solar radiation and emits longwave upward
没有大气的对照面：没有削弱、也没有逆辐射: A comparison surface with no atmosphere: no weakening and no counter-radiation
太阳辐射穿过大气，少掉的那部分去哪了？: As solar radiation passes through the atmosphere, where does the missing part go?
拖动视角绕剖面台看一圈：浅黄色的短波箭头从上方竖直射下，一部分在大气上界折返: Drag the view around the cross-section: pale yellow shortwave arrows come straight down from above, and part of them turns back at the top of the atmosphere
入射的年均 340 W·m⁻² 里，云与大气反射 75、大气吸收短波 80、到达: Of the 340 W·m⁻² annual mean coming in, clouds and air reflect 75, the atmosphere absorbs 80 of shortwave, and 185 reaches the ground; weakening totals 155, and 155 + 185 = 340
参考工况 · 全球年平均（AR6 图 7.2）: Reference conditions · global annual mean (AR6 Fig. 7.2)
教材图 2.9 / 2.10 不画云，这里的云 = 参考工况云量 65 %: Textbook Figs. 2.9 / 2.10 show no clouds; the cloud here = reference cloud cover 65 %
大气中的一切物理过程都伴随着能量转换，太阳辐射是地球大气最重要的能量来源。: Every physical process in the atmosphere involves energy conversion, and solar radiation is the atmosphere's most important energy source.
投射到地球上的太阳辐射要穿过厚厚的大气才能到达地面：小部分被大气吸收或反射，大部: Solar radiation reaching Earth must pass through a thick atmosphere to reach the ground: a small part is absorbed or reflected by the atmosphere, and most reaches the surface.
大气削弱 = 大气吸收 + 云与大气的反射 = 80 + 75 = 155（地面: Atmospheric weakening = absorption by the atmosphere + reflection by clouds and air = 80 + 75 = 155 (the 25 reflected by the ground is not atmospheric weakening; that belongs to the ground side, covered in step 2).
去掉这一步：学生会以为太阳辐射「原样」到地面，「削弱 + 到达地面 = 入射」这: Skip this step and students think solar radiation reaches the ground "as is", leaving the conservation "weakening + reaching the ground = incoming" with nothing to stand on.
常考：削弱作用 = 吸收 + 反射；说成「只有吸收」是错项。: Common exam point: weakening = absorption + reflection; saying "absorption only" is a wrong option.
太阳辐射在传播过程中小部分被大气吸收或反射、大部分到达地面；大气削弱 = 大气吸: On its way, a small part of solar radiation is absorbed or reflected by the atmosphere and most reaches the ground; atmospheric weakening = absorption 80 + reflection by clouds and air 75 = 155, not absorption alone.
facts A2.1-b、A7-8；B2.1 式 1、表 1-1、B2.4 D7: facts A2.1-b, A7-8; B2.1 eq. 1, table 1-1, B2.4 D7
到达地面的太阳辐射，全都用来升温了吗？: Is all the solar radiation reaching the ground used to warm it?
把「地表反照率」拖到新雪 0.80，看地面吸收的那一段怎么缩、向上反射的那一段怎: Drag "surface albedo" to fresh snow, 0.80, and see the ground-absorbed segment shrink while the upward reflected segment grows
到达地面仍是 185，但地面吸收由 160 掉到 37、向上的反射那一支明显变长: Still 185 reaches the ground, but ground absorption drops from 160 to 37 and the upward reflected branch grows clearly longer; daytime warming falls from 5.8 ℃ to 1.3 ℃
吸收的那部分才升温: Only the absorbed part warms it
到达地球表面的太阳辐射，被地面吸收和反射——不是全部用来升温。: Solar radiation reaching Earth's surface is absorbed and reflected by the ground; not all of it warms the ground.
吸收的那一部分才让地面增温；反射掉的那一部分回到大气与宇宙空间。: Only the absorbed part warms the ground; the reflected part goes back to the atmosphere and space.
反照率是地表自己的属性：全球平均 0.135，新雪 0.80，所以雪面上地面吸收: Albedo is a property of the surface itself: 0.135 on global average, 0.80 for fresh snow, so on snow the ground absorbs only 37 W·m⁻².
去掉这一步：学生会把「到达地面 185」直接当成「升温用的 185」，白天地面吸: Skip this step and students take "185 reaching the ground" as "185 used for warming", breaking the daytime ground absorption path.
易错：认为到达地面的太阳辐射全部用于升温（事实表 A7-10）。: Common mistake: thinking all solar radiation reaching the ground is used for warming (fact table A7-10).
到达地面的太阳辐射被地面吸收和反射，只有吸收的那部分增温；反照率越高、吸收越少。: Solar radiation reaching the ground is absorbed and reflected, and only the absorbed part warms it; the higher the albedo, the less is absorbed.
facts A2.1-c、A7-10；B2.1 式 2、表 1-1 与第 5 行: facts A2.1-c, A7-10; B2.1 eq. 2, table 1-1 and row 5, B2.4 D8
地面一升温，凭什么自己就往上「发热」？: Once the ground warms, why does it "give off heat" upward by itself?
看 12 秒：橙色长波从地面升起，读出地面的温度与最强波长，和太阳的比一比: Watch for 12 s: orange longwave rises from the ground; read the ground's temperature and peak wavelength and compare them with the Sun's
地面温度 289.4 K、最强波长 10.01 µm；太阳 0.50 µm；两者: Ground temperature 289.4 K, peak wavelength 10.01 µm; Sun 0.50 µm; a factor of 19.94 apart, which is where shortwave and longwave come from
由实验得知：物体的温度越高，辐射中最强部分的波长越短；反之则波长越长。: Experiments show: the hotter an object, the shorter the wavelength of the strongest part of its radiation; the cooler, the longer.
太阳有效温度 5772 K，最强波长 0.50 µm，落在可见光；地面约 289: The Sun's effective temperature is 5772 K, peaking at 0.50 µm in visible light; the ground is about 289.4 K, peaking at 10.01 µm in the infrared.
波长差 19.94 倍，这才是「太阳辐射是短波、地面辐射是长波」的来历；地面长波: The 19.94-fold wavelength difference is why "solar radiation is shortwave and ground radiation is longwave"; ground longwave is the main, direct heat source of the air near the ground.
去掉这一步：「短波 / 长波」成了背下来的标签，下一步为什么要挑波长吸收就没了根: Skip this step and "shortwave / longwave" become memorized labels, with no basis for why absorption picks out wavelengths in the next step.
易错：把地面辐射说成短波（温度越低，最强波长越长）。: Common mistake: calling ground radiation shortwave (the lower the temperature, the longer the peak wavelength).
温度越高、辐射最强部分的波长越短；地面温度远低于太阳，所以太阳辐射是短波、地面辐: The higher the temperature, the shorter the peak wavelength; the ground is far cooler than the Sun, so solar radiation is shortwave and ground radiation longwave, and ground longwave is the main direct heat source of the air near the ground.
facts A2.1-d、A2.2-b、本章要点 5；B2.1 式 5、B2.4: facts A2.1-d, A2.2-b, chapter key point 5; B2.1 eq. 5, B2.4 D5
射上去的长波，有多少被大气截住了？: How much of the longwave going up is trapped by the atmosphere?
点一下画面里向上那支橙色「地面长波」箭头：被吸收的那一段和透过的那一段会分开显示: Click the upward orange "ground longwave" arrow in the scene: the absorbed part and the part that escapes are shown separately
地面长波 398 里，342 被大气吸收、56 穿出大气上界；吸收比例 86 %: Of 398 in ground longwave, 342 is absorbed by the atmosphere and 56 escapes through the top; the absorbed share is 86 %, within the textbook's 75%–95%
从大气的受热过程看：大气对太阳短波辐射吸收较少，对地面长波辐射吸收较多。: In how the atmosphere is heated: it absorbs little solar shortwave but much of the ground's longwave.
地面长波除极少部分穿过大气到达宇宙空间外，绝大部分（75%—95%）被对流层中的: Apart from a very small part that passes through to space, most ground longwave (75%–95%) is absorbed by water vapor, carbon dioxide and so on in the troposphere.
参考工况的吸收比例是 86 %，正好落在教材给的区间里。: The absorbed share in the reference conditions is 86 %, right within the textbook's range.
去掉这一步：学生会把「大气增温」归因于「大气吸收太阳辐射」——这是本课最高频的错: Skip this step and students attribute "the atmosphere warming" to "the atmosphere absorbing solar radiation", the most frequent mistake in this lesson (A7-1).
易错：认为大气直接吸收太阳辐射而增温。正确：大气对短波吸收少，主要、直接的热源是: Common mistake: thinking the atmosphere warms by directly absorbing solar radiation. Correct: it absorbs little shortwave, and its main, direct heat source is ground longwave.
地面长波除极少部分穿过大气外，绝大部分（75%—95%）被对流层的水汽、二氧化碳: Apart from a very small part that passes through, most ground longwave (75%–95%) is absorbed by tropospheric water vapor and carbon dioxide, and that is how the atmosphere warms.
facts A2.2-a、A2.2-c、A7-1；B2.1 式 3、表 1-1、: facts A2.2-a, A2.2-c, A7-1; B2.1 eq. 3, table 1-1, B2.4 D12
大气逆辐射凭什么叫「逆」，它怎么保温？: Why is atmospheric counter-radiation called "counter", and how does it keep the ground warm?
点一下向下那支红橙色「大气逆辐射」箭头，看它和地面长波的方向正好相反: Click the downward red-orange "atmospheric counter-radiation" arrow and see that it points exactly opposite to the ground longwave
地面向上发出 398，大气向下还回 342，夜间净损失只剩 56；两支箭头方向相: The ground sends up 398, the atmosphere sends 342 back down, leaving a net nighttime loss of only 56; the two arrows point opposite ways
大气在增温的同时也向外辐射长波：一小部分向上射向宇宙空间，大部分向下射向地面。: As it warms, the atmosphere also emits longwave: a small part upward to space, most downward to the ground.
向下这一支的方向与地面辐射方向相反，所以叫大气逆辐射。: This downward branch runs opposite to ground radiation, so it is called atmospheric counter-radiation.
逆辐射把热量还给地面，补偿地面辐射损失的热量：398 出去、342 回来，夜间净: Counter-radiation returns heat to the ground, making up for heat lost by ground radiation: 398 out, 342 back, a net nighttime loss of only 56 W·m⁻².
去掉这一步：学生只会说「大气保温」，说不出保温是从哪一支箭头来的。: Skip this step and students can only say "the atmosphere keeps things warm" without saying which arrow does it.
易错：把「大气辐射」整体叫成逆辐射；只有向下射向地面的那一支才叫大气逆辐射。: Common mistake: calling all atmospheric radiation counter-radiation; only the branch directed down to the ground is atmospheric counter-radiation.
大气逆辐射方向与地面辐射相反，它补偿地面辐射损失的热量，对地面起保温作用。: Atmospheric counter-radiation runs opposite to ground radiation; it makes up for heat the ground loses by radiation and keeps the ground warm.
facts A2.2-d、本章要点 6、A7-3/4；B2.1 式 3、B2.4: facts A2.2-d, chapter key point 6, A7-3/4; B2.1 eq. 3, B2.4 D4
云多的一天，为什么早晚温差反而更小？: Why is the morning–evening temperature range smaller on a cloudy day?
把「云量」从多云 65 % 拖到阴 100 %：看白天进来的一支变短、夜间还回来: Drag "cloud cover" from cloudy 65 % to overcast 100 %: the daytime incoming branch shortens and the branch returned at night grows
到达地面 185 → 156、大气逆辐射 342 → 357、昼夜温差 7.8: Reaching the ground 185 → 156, counter-radiation 342 → 357, day–night range 7.8 → 6.3 ℃; compare with a clear sky at 240 / 314 / 10.5 ℃
全晴 ↔ 全阴（本课曲线横轴是云量）: Clear ↔ overcast (this lesson's curve has cloud cover on the horizontal axis)
天空有云，特别是浓密的低云时，大气逆辐射更强。: With clouds in the sky, especially thick low clouds, atmospheric counter-radiation is stronger.
白天云把更多太阳辐射反射回太空，到达地面的那一支变少。: By day clouds reflect more solar radiation back to space, so less reaches the ground.
夜间云让逆辐射更强、地面净损失变小。两头一起压温差：全晴 10.5 ℃、全阴 6: At night clouds strengthen counter-radiation and reduce the ground's net loss. Both ends squeeze the range: 10.5 ℃ when clear, 6.3 ℃ when overcast.
去掉这一步：学生会把云当成「只会降温」的东西（A7-6）。: Skip this step and students treat clouds as something that "only cools" (A7-6).
常考：阴天昼夜温差小的原因（白天削弱强 + 夜间逆辐射强）；晴朗夜晚易霜冻。: Common exam point: why the day–night range is small on overcast days (strong weakening by day + strong counter-radiation at night); frost forms easily on clear nights.
云是双向的：白天削弱更强使到达地面变少、夜间逆辐射更强使净损失变小，所以阴天昼夜: Clouds work both ways: by day stronger weakening means less reaches the ground, at night stronger counter-radiation means a smaller net loss, so overcast days have a small day–night range and clear nights are prone to frost.
facts A2.2-e、A5 云的作用、A6；B2.1 式 1/3/4、表 1: facts A2.2-e, A5 role of clouds, A6; B2.1 eqs. 1/3/4, table 1-1 rows 2/3, B2.4 D1–D3
温室气体多了一点，哪一格读数变了？: With a bit more greenhouse gas, which readings change?
把「水汽与二氧化碳含量」拖到 1.5 倍，盯住白天的读数有没有动: Drag "water vapor and carbon dioxide content" to 1.5× and watch whether the daytime readings move
大气逆辐射 342 → 354、夜间净损失 56 → 44、夜间降温 2.0 →: Counter-radiation 342 → 354, nighttime net loss 56 → 44, nighttime cooling 2.0 → 1.6 ℃; while reaching the ground 185, ground absorption 160 and weakening 155 stay exactly the same
温室气体只吃长波（丁达尔实验）: Greenhouse gases only take longwave (Tyndall's experiment)
丁达尔用实验证实：红外辐射能穿透氧气和氮气，但不能穿透二氧化碳和水汽——这就是「: Tyndall showed by experiment that infrared radiation passes through oxygen and nitrogen but not through carbon dioxide and water vapor, the main "greenhouse gases".
温室气体增加，只增强大气逆辐射：342 → 354，夜间净损失降到 44 W·m: More greenhouse gas only strengthens counter-radiation: 342 → 354, with nighttime net loss down to 44 W·m⁻².
白天那一串读数（到达地面、地面吸收、削弱）一格不动，这就是「温室气体只吃长波」的: The daytime readings (reaching the ground, ground absorption, weakening) do not move at all; that is what "greenhouse gases only take longwave" looks like on screen.
去掉这一步：从本节到「全球气候变化」的桥断了，学生不知道增强的温室效应是哪一支箭: Skip this step and the bridge from this section to "global climate change" is broken; students won't know which arrow an enhanced greenhouse effect strengthens.
易错：认为氧气、氮气吸收地面长波；能吸收长波的是水汽、二氧化碳等温室气体。: Common mistake: thinking oxygen and nitrogen absorb ground longwave; it is greenhouse gases such as water vapor and carbon dioxide that do.
温室气体只吸收长波：增加后只增强大气逆辐射、保温更强，白天的读数不变——这就是人: Greenhouse gases absorb only longwave: more of them only strengthens counter-radiation and warming, with daytime readings unchanged; this is how human activity enhances the greenhouse effect.
facts A2.2-f、A7-9；B2.1 式 3、表 1-1 第 4 行、B: facts A2.2-f, A7-9; B2.1 eq. 3, table 1-1 row 4, B2.4 D6
月球白天更晒，为什么昼夜温差反而大得多？: The Moon gets even more sun by day. Why is its day–night range so much larger?
把「大气层」关掉，切到月球表面：看少了哪几支箭头: Switch the "atmosphere" off to get the Moon's surface: see which arrows are missing
关掉大气后，到达地面 185 → 340、削弱 155 → 0、大气逆辐射 34: With the atmosphere off, reaching the ground 185 → 340, weakening 155 → 0, counter-radiation 342 → 0, nighttime net loss 56 → 398; day–night range 7.8 → 24.9 ℃; the Earth bench now looks just like the Moon bench on the left
地球有大气 · 月球几乎没有大气: Earth has an atmosphere · the Moon has almost none
月球几乎没有大气，所以既没有大气对太阳辐射的削弱，也没有大气逆辐射。: The Moon has almost no atmosphere, so there is neither weakening of solar radiation nor counter-radiation.
白天太阳辐射全部到达月面（340），夜里地面长波全部跑掉（净损失 398）。: By day all solar radiation reaches the lunar surface (340); at night all ground longwave escapes (net loss 398).
两头一拉，昼夜温差 24.9 ℃，远大于地球的 7.8 ℃（示意）。: Pulled at both ends, the day–night range is 24.9 ℃, far more than Earth's 7.8 ℃ (illustrative).
去掉这一步：教材活动第 3 题没有画面对应，保温作用缺一个「只差大气这一个条件」: Skip this step and textbook activity question 3 has no matching picture, and the warming effect lacks a comparison that differs "only by the atmosphere".
常考：月球昼夜温差大的原因——没有大气削弱、没有大气逆辐射。: Common exam point: why the Moon's day–night range is large: no atmospheric weakening and no counter-radiation.
月球没有大气：既没有削弱（白天到达更多），也没有大气逆辐射（夜间损失更大），所以: The Moon has no atmosphere: no weakening (more arrives by day) and no counter-radiation (more is lost at night), so its day–night temperature swings are far more extreme than Earth's.
